description.html: This glass terrarium (65x40x40 cm, 104 L) comes with exterior decorative film in a pattern of your choice. The glass gives a clear view of the inside, while film on three sides gives the animals a sense of security.

A length of 65 cm and a width of 40 cm provide a large floor area for ground-dwelling species. The ample length allows a temperature gradient from a warm to a cool zone, which every reptile needs to stay healthy. Ventilation is provided by mesh openings that allow airflow and humidity control inside the terrarium.

When ordering, you choose the film pattern and the shape of the 3D background. We handmake all our terrariums in Novi Sad, so customization is always possible, from dimensions to the way it opens. We ship by courier throughout Serbia.
